source.title: Existence of Economic Equilibrium: New Results and Open Problems

evidence.quote: The purpose of the present paper is twofold: First of all, we consider some recent developments in the theory of existence of competitive equilibrium, most of which will be of interest mainly from a technical point of view. Secondly, we shall argue that although the competitive equilibrium is a field where economically interesting new results may seem unlikely to appear, the theory of existence of economic equilibria in general is a much broader field where much is left for future research.
